problem: The closing sentence says "That is why 2f + 1 nodes are needed and 2f + 1 votes are needed", which contradicts the bound the answer just derived. The node count required for Byzantine fault tolerance is 3f + 1, not 2f + 1; 2f + 1 is the quorum size. A student revising from this answer would write the wrong bound in the exam.
fix: "That is why n ≥ 3f + 1 nodes are needed and 2f + 1 votes are needed, that is, why fewer than one third of the network may be faulty."
